name: FREAK
description: FREAK is a comprehensive multimodal benchmark designed for fine-grained hallucination assessment in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It uses high-quality photorealistic images with fine-grained counter-commonsense edits to evaluate hallucination phenomena in detailed visual perception.
reputation: A very recent multimodal hallucination benchmark that is gaining attention for fine-grained evaluation of MLLMs, but it is not yet broadly established.
notes: Addresses hallucination in MLLMs with fine-grained visual perception tasks; includes a controlled subset for indirect evaluation.
